verdict.line: You lose if you trade Q for Q into his 2-stack pull before level 6; you win if you stall to Sunfire Aegis/Thornmail and let his all-in waste itself into your W (Brutal Strikes) and E (Ground Slam).

brief.thesis: K'Sante's Q (Ntofo Strikes) builds stacks every 3.5s and fires a pull shockwave at 2 stacks, which is what actually wins him the trade and the lane stat (50.4% over 1168 games, lane and solo-kill edge both his). Malphite has no comparable early poke pressure — his kit is built to absorb and scale, not to win 1-2 trades — so the matchup is about surviving his stack-and-pull windows until your armor-scaling E and tank itemization make you the stronger body in extended fights.

theirWindow.when: He's landed a Q and is near you again
theirWindow.what: At 2 stacks his Q fires a pull shockwave that drags you into range of his E (Footwork) dash-shield and auto combo. Don't stand in a second Q's path once you see he's already hit one — back off or use Q (Seismic Shard) to steal his movement speed and disengage instead of trading face to face.

yourWindow.what: Footwork is his only dash/shield and it's down for 10 to 8.5 seconds depending on rank. With it gone he has no clean disengage, so this is when you step in with Q poke and hold W (Brutal Strikes) ready for the armor/AD buff if he commits anyway.

start.why: This is the most-picked (66.3%) and highest-winning (51% over 919 games) start in this matchup — the extra Health Potion sustain matters more than Doran's Shield's flat block against a champion whose damage comes in burst packages from Q stacks and W, not sustained poke.

boots.why: 73.2% pick, 51.4% win rate. K'Sante's damage is physical and auto-attack-reliant through his Q marks and on-hit passive stacking, so flat armor plus the auto-attack damage reduction directly undercuts his trade pattern.

core.why: First item in the highest-sample core path (51.5% over 68 games) — gives you the HP and armor to actually survive his level 6-8 all-in window before you have anything else.
Directly punishes his on-hit passive stacking and auto-reliant damage, which is the core of how he wins trades and all-ins.
Closes out the 51.5%-winrate path with attack speed slow that further neuters his auto-attack combo and Q stack generation.

runes.keystoneWhy: 51.4% win rate at 34.6% pick — the sustained HP regen and bonus health matter because this lane is about outlasting his stack-and-pull windows, not winning single exchanges. Master-tier players instead run Arcane Comet (Sorcery, 48.6% pick) for the poke damage; that suits a more aggressive Malphite trying to punish his Q cooldown directly rather than just stall to items.

summoners.why: Flash+Teleport is run in 83.8% of games here — Teleport lets you play the lane passively and still return from base with items or help a sidelane once you've stalled past his all-in windows. Flash+Ignite (54.8% win rate, 13.7% pick) is the higher-winrate alternative if you're comfortable fighting for an early kill instead of scaling.

playing.title: Don't contest his first Q stack
playing.detail: Letting him land one Ntofo Strikes for free costs little; standing in range for the second means eating the pull shockwave into his follow-up. Walk out of line-of-sight range after he lands the first hit.

playing.title: Poke with Q, don't melee trade
playing.detail: Seismic Shard (8s cooldown, 625 range) outranges his Q (450 range) and steals his movement speed, letting you kite instead of standing in auto range where his stacks build.

playing.title: Respect his W charge-up
playing.detail: Path Maker (14 to 10s cooldown by rank) has a charge-up phase where he takes reduced damage before dashing into a knockback and stun. Don't walk toward him while he's visibly charging — back off and let it whiff.

playing.title: Play passive through level 6-8
playing.detail: His R (All Out) knocks you through terrain and then transforms his kit for a sustained-damage all-in with healing. You have no kill pressure to match it yet — farm safely and wait for Sunfire Aegis.

playing.title: Use E for the attack-speed cut when he commits
playing.detail: Ground Slam (7s cooldown, 400 range) deals magic damage based on your armor and slows his attack speed — this is your best tool for blunting an All Out combo once he's already in range.

playing.title: Pop W before he reaches you, not after
playing.detail: Brutal Strikes (14s cooldown) buffs your armor and attack damage for a short window — activate it as he closes the gap so the armor is up before his burst lands, not as a panic button mid-trade.

playing.title: Save R for his dive, not the opener
playing.detail: Unstoppable Force (130 down to 80s cooldown, 1000 range) is your teamfight tool once you've scaled — don't burn it early just to interrupt a lane trade when the cooldown is this long.

brief.patchCaveat: The build path, win rates, and pick rates above are measured from live games on the current patch via OP.GG; the tactical reading of why each item and rune matters against K'Sante's stack-and-pull pattern is my own analysis, not sourced data.
